title: Schwarz: Solver-Aware Agentic Program Verification
title_zh: Schwarz：求解器感知的智能体程序验证
abstract_en: Agentic verification systems can often generate source-level specifications that look plausible, but plausibility is not enough: the verifier must still turn those specifications into SMT obligations that the solver can prove. When this step fails, current LLM-driven loops usually expose only a coarse verifier error, timeout, or unknown solver result. The model cannot tell whether the specification is wrong, a helper lemma is missing, the proof context contains irrelevant facts, or the obligation needs a different theory view. This paper presents Schwarz, an agentic verification harness that makes SMT-backed proof failure local, checkable, and repairable. Schwarz turns failed verification into obligation-local repair tasks: program-point snapshots expose checked facts at a boundary, local lemmas let the agent propose missing proof steps, and theory-aware solver policies guide the agent toward solver-friendly formulations for numeric, quantified, memory, and floating-point obligations. We implement Schwarz for C and Rust/Verus and evaluate it on 1,475 tasks. On 475 benchmarks from recent agentic verification tools, Schwarz solves 95.2% of the tasks. On 1,000 tasks from the SV-COMP 2026 ReachSafety track, averaging 1,427 LOC, Schwarz solves 91.5% of the tasks, compared with 60.1% for CPAchecker. Ablations and comparison with a pure-agent baseline show that solver-aware repair is effective and scalable.
abstract_zh: 智能体程序验证系统通常能够生成看似合理的源码级规约，但仅有合理性并不足够：验证器还必须将这些规约转换为 SMT 证明义务，并使求解器成功完成证明。当这一过程失败时，现有 LLM 驱动的迭代流程通常只能获得粗粒度的验证器错误、超时或 unknown 结果，因而难以判断究竟是规约错误、缺少辅助引理、证明上下文包含无关事实，还是证明义务需要采用不同的理论表示。本文提出 Schwarz，一种面向智能体的验证框架，旨在使基于 SMT 的证明失败能够被局部定位、检查和修复。Schwarz 将验证失败转化为证明义务局部的修复任务：程序点快照用于暴露边界处已检查的事实，局部引理允许智能体补充缺失的证明步骤，而理论感知的求解器策略则针对数值、量词、内存和浮点证明义务，引导智能体生成更适合求解器处理的表达。作者为 C 和 Rust/Verus 实现了 Schwarz，并在 1,475 个任务上进行评测。在来自近期智能体程序验证工具的 475 个基准上，Schwarz 的解决率达到 95.2%；在 SV-COMP 2026 ReachSafety 赛道的 1,000 个任务上，程序平均规模为 1,427 LOC，Schwarz 解决了 91.5% 的任务，而 CPAchecker 为 60.1%。消融实验及与纯智能体基线的比较表明，求解器感知修复具有良好的有效性与可扩展性。
key_points_zh: 将 SMT 验证失败拆分为证明义务局部的、可检查且可修复的智能体任务。
通过程序点快照和局部引理，帮助智能体识别缺失事实并补充关键证明步骤。
针对数值、量词、内存和浮点问题采用理论感知的求解器策略，生成更易证明的规约与义务。
支持 C 与 Rust/Verus；在 475 个近期智能体验证基准上取得 95.2% 的解决率。
在 1,000 个 SV-COMP 2026 ReachSafety 任务上达到 91.5%，显著超过 CPAchecker 的 60.1%。

llm_assessment.comment: Schwarz is a strong coding-agent harness that turns opaque solver failures into localized, checkable, and repairable verification tasks.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: Schwarz是一个较强的编码智能体框架，能够将不透明的求解器失败转化为局部、可检查且可修复的验证任务。
